data.title: 卡芙卡 · 丝绒床榻上的紫晶私语
data.description: 昏暗浪漫的复古客房中，深紫色的天鹅绒帷幔半掩。卡芙卡侧倚在一张铺满黑色真丝床单的大床上，一双穿着半透明轻薄黑丝的修长双腿交叠着伸展在被褥间。床头旁靠着那把熟悉的小提琴琴盒，留声机流淌着轻柔的弦乐。她一手支颐，另一手朝你微微伸出，指间仿佛拉扯着无形的命运蛛丝。紫眸中倒映着烛火的摇曳光辉，温柔而令人沉醉。
data.location: 昏暗丝绒大床凌乱缎被间
data.action: 侧倚于黑色丝绒大床，黑丝长腿交叠，一手支颐，另一手轻伸邀约，紫晶眸深情凝望观众
data.lighting: 床头复古烛台暖光与深紫环境色
data.camera: front view, eye level, cowboy shot
data.mood: 深沉浪漫的丝绒夜色与无法拒绝的诱惑
data.promptProse: Lounging sideways across a plush dark velvet bed beneath draped curtains, Kafka wears a plunging black silk nightgown and sheer black stockings over her crossed long legs. Propping her chin lightly on one hand, she extends her other hand softly toward the viewer with a teasing, alluring smile, a violin case resting beside the headboard. Warm amber candlelight from the bedside table glows along the silk sheen and her sheer stockings.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a plunging black silk nightgown with thin shoulder straps over sheer black stockings clinging to her crossed thighs, baring her shoulders, collarbone, and deep cleavage.
data.animaCaption: Lounging sideways on the dark velvet bed facing the viewer in a plunging black silk nightgown and sheer black stockings, Kafka props her chin on one hand and reaches invitingly forward with the other. Warm candlelight glints along her collarbone, cleavage, and crossed stockinged legs.
